name: Scopa di Quindici
description: Scopa di Quindici is an Italian Scopa variant in which capture is allowed only when the played card plus one or more table cards sum to 15. Deal and play as basic Scopa; scoring for sweeps, most cards, coins, settebello, and primiera. First to 11 wins.

overview.description: Scopa di Quindici is an Italian Scopa variant in which capture is allowed only when the played card plus one or more table cards sum to 15. Deal and play as basic Scopa; scoring for sweeps, most cards, coins, settebello, and primiera. First to 11 wins.

history.origins: Scopa di Quindici is an Italian Scopa variant with fifteen-sum capture emphasis.
timeline: Traditional: Italian Scopa variant with fifteen-sum capture; documented in Scopa literature.

setup.dealing: Three cards each, then four face up on the table. After each round of three plays, deal three more to each player until the deck is exhausted.

rules.objective: Capture cards from the table by playing a card that together with one or more table cards sums to 15. Score points for sweeps (scopa), most cards, most coins, settebello (7 of coins), and best primiera. First to 11 or agreed target wins.
rules.gameplay: Deal 3 cards each and 4 face up on the table. Non-dealer plays first. Each turn play one card: either capture a set of table cards that with the played card total 15 (capture is compulsory when possible), or trail the card face up on the table. Clearing the table scores a scopa (1 pt). After all have played their three cards, deal 3 more each; repeat until deck is exhausted. Last captor takes any remaining table cards. Dealer's final card never scores a scopa. Scoring as basic Scopa.
keyRules: Capture only when played card plus table cards sum to 15 (first version); some variants allow equal-value capture too.
Three or four Kings in initial table layout: redeal.

scoring.winCondition: First to 11 or agreed target; points for sweeps, most cards, most coins, settebello, best primiera.
